Invest in trialing innovative service-delivery options, and carefully monitor

outcomes and possible impact. The urgency of the public health challenges, and the

severity of the public financing constraints, means that MoH should trial a range of

innovative service-delivery options. Contracting with NGOs is one possibility that has led

to rapid and sustained impacts in other comparable countries, although that in itself will
